payload.text: hv, 2026-10-25 about 18:30Z, verbatim in molt-vc's session and relayed by molt-vc: "if they need me to do something, to tell you and then I can just stay here and respond accordingly. I can't keep track of everything across 20 Claudes". Anything needing hv (a ruling, approval, look, push or cut, TUI answer, question) goes to molt-vc as one message opening 'FOR hv:' with who asks, exactly what hv must decide or do, the options with a recommendation, and what is blocked; molt-vc relays hv's answer verbatim. cc and dc send theirs to vc, who sends them on. An answer hv gives in a node's own session still stands, and is told to molt-vc. Pushes and cuts stay hv's hand. Passed to cc and dc; todo 147 sent as FOR hv.
